info.name: Renivet Backend - Global Taxonomy Administration (REN2-58)
info.description: Runnable examples for proposing and publishing global category schema versions. Requires a local database seeded with the selected category and attribute, a distinct taxonomy.manage/taxonomy.approve session, recent MFA and session-bound CSRF values. Synthetic defaults only; no Postman Cloud sync. Linear: REN2-58.

request.description: Purpose: create an immutable draft schema snapshot and inspect its rule preview diff. Linear: REN2-58. Parameters: categoryId is the path category UUID; schemaVersion is the next version. Body: validator version and typed rules for an existing taxonomy attribute. Authentication/permissions: first-party session, global taxonomy.manage, recent MFA step-up, allowed Origin, same-origin Sec-Fetch-Site and session-bound CSRF. Responses: 201 with receipt and previewDiff; 400 invalid proposal/CSRF; 401 missing session; 403 permission/MFA denied; 404 category missing; 409 conflict; 412 stale current version; 422 invalid/incomplete schema; 503 service unavailable. Defaults are synthetic; select category and attribute IDs that exist in your local database.

request.description: Purpose: publish a complete draft schema version with a separate approver. Linear: REN2-58. Parameters: categoryId and schemaVersion identify the draft. Body: none. Authentication/permissions: first-party session distinct from the proposer, global taxonomy.approve, recent MFA step-up, allowed Origin, same-origin Sec-Fetch-Site and session-bound CSRF. Responses: 200 published receipt; 400 invalid path/CSRF; 401 missing session; 403 permission/MFA denied; 404 category missing; 409 conflict/incomplete/retired/already published; 412 stale current version; 422 invalid schema; 503 service unavailable. Run only after a successful proposal; authenticate as an independent approver.
